posts.text: Today we honor the men and women who served. Thank you for your courage, your sacrifice, and your service to our nation. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/ZaFHO8KBfQ
🚨 I will be live on @CNNSitRoom with @PamelaBrownCNN at 11:00am. Tune in!
Today is Election Day! Not sure where to vote? Find your polling location here: https://t.co/Gzt5sAwPj7 https://t.co/ZIeWqRs7ad

I will always fight to protect the earned benefits of workers. Employee benefits are not a gift, they are earned. Workers make career and retirement decisions based on the compensation and benefits they are promised in exchange for their service. When those benefits have been earned, promises should be kept.

💡Learn more: https://t.co/PjX0sssbWW
🎃 Happy Halloween! Please be safe trick-or-treating and celebrate responsibility. https://t.co/xhuruoX5pI

I am proud to work with @RepDaveJoyce and the Ohio congressional delegation to urge the @usairforce to bring the Air Force Reserve Command’s 33rd Combat Communications Squadron to the Youngstown Air Reserve Station (YARS). This would create more jobs for Ohio while strengthening a national security asset.

Read our letter here: https://t.co/YtVoXCDRSZ

One of the most important things my office does is help people with federal problems. Although my office cannot override the decisions made by a federal agency, it can often intervene on a person's behalf to answer questions, find solutions, or just cut through the red tape. https://t.co/gI80FsKElv

Attracting the next generation of high-quality jobs to the Miami Valley is made possible by our world-class universities, our development-friendly infrastructure, skilled workforce, and strong advocacy in Washington for projects that are nationally competitive. https://t.co/7JYHr19RrK

A government takeover of healthcare is not the answer.

Increasing transparency, competition, and options while eliminating middlemen that come between you and your care lowers costs and enhances quality. All without a federal bureaucracy delaying your treatment. https://t.co/1Ht4clVHVk

64 years ago today, the world held its breath as the prospect of nuclear war seemed imminent. President Kennedy faced a critical choice with enormous risk, and didn’t blink. The nuclear standoff ended with Khrushchev backing down. The Cuban Missile Crisis showed the world that American courage is our greatest strength, and we will never shrink in the face of a threat, no matter how dire.

Your hard work keeps America working. You deserve to keep more of your paycheck and thanks to the Working Family Tax Cuts Act, you can. A higher standard deduction, no tax on tips, an increased child tax credit, and more. Every working American deserves to have their work rewarded.
America cannot remain a superpower if our adversaries continue to build everything we want and need. America must build again. Create jobs. Enhance security. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/FjBiCKjX8O

Through the NATO alliance, America projects power across the globe. The bonds with our democratic allies strengthen and safeguard our shared values. NATO is the strongest alliance the world has ever seen. https://t.co/VkM4FG1eIx

Today is National Day of the Deployed. To our brave men and women who are serving far from home, we honor and thank you for your service and sacrifice in the name of freedom. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/rKQH4GmrZY

Wright-Patt has a $16.68B impact on the region. This means new, high-paying jobs, economic growth and development, improved infrastructure, and more opportunities.

This impact means a stronger Miami Valley and a stronger America. https://t.co/GUVkWmVjyy

I recently spoke to the @daytonregion  and the @DaytonChamber at their Regional Economic Development Forum. Throughout my time in public service, economic development has been a major focus of mine.

Since @JobsOhio was founded in 2011, our community has created 50,000 jobs. https://t.co/nY3pIueBXB

Southwest Ohio is home to over 60,000 veterans, representing a sizable portion of our community's population. Our men and women in uniform sacrifice a great deal to serve our country and we owe them and their families a great deal of respect. That is why I have authored and https://t.co/JepbXnCxKq

I recently toured Battle Sight Technologies, a provider of innovative front-line technologies for our warfighters, law enforcement and first responders. Located right here in Dayton, Battle Sight Technologies keeps our spirit of innovation alive while providing for our national https://t.co/EUlZpIlBPM

National security starts on the factory floor. When we make critical materials at home like steel, munitions and parts, we reduce our dependence on foreign supply chains in a crisis. The plants that make these vital components for our defense also provide stable job opportunities for our communities. American manufacturing protects the nation and builds the middle class.

I am proud to have secured $8.68 million in federal funding for the improvement and rehabilitation of the Germantown, Englewood and Taylorsville dams. This project is tied for the largest individual earmark in the FY26 Homeland Security appropriations bill, secured by any member of the House or Senate.

Part of being a community leader is protecting the things that protect others, and the Miami Conservancy District - MCD is an excellent steward of our region’s historical and vital dam system. Since the construction of these dams in the wake of the Great Flood of 1913, they have kept our community safe for 100 years.

This investment will ensure the protection of the critical infrastructure that protects our region, keeping Ohioans safe for many years to come.

It is an honor to recognize those who do so much for our community. I am happy to have presented this years Congressional Community Service Award to Jenell Ross. Whether through her business, her philanthropy or her service to organizations across our community, Jenell has always https://t.co/nco6LDKaDk

More than fifty years ago, as one of the deadliest storms in our region’s history closed in on Xenia, Gil Whitney, a local @whiotv weatherman, identified the imminent danger and took action to warn his neighbors.

Folks in Xenia still remember that warning and the lives Gil https://t.co/0bgbEFucqC
People deserve the opportunity to earn a good paycheck and the security of knowing the pension they worked for will be there when they retire. That's what I'm fighting for. https://t.co/sfFQQ2KDwh
🚨I will be on @FaceTheNation with @margbrennan this morning, tune in!

Since 1775, our U.S. Navy sailors have defended our nation, protected global sea lanes, and answered the call around the world. To every sailor serving today, every veteran, and every family that supports them, thank you. Happy Birthday to the U.S. Navy. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/Kfz9sgnLMh

@wrightstate, @WrightPattAFB and the @usairforce  have a unique relationship that has been a part of who we are as a region for generations. 

On November 2nd the Stars, Stripes and Flight Classic will feature the Wright State University Raiders and the Air Force Academy Falcons at the Nutter Center. Events like this bring us together and celebrate the connection between our military and civilian communities.

Today is World Mental Health Day, but it important to remember everyday that no one should have to struggle in silence. Check in on your loved ones, and if you or someone you know is in crisis call or text 988 and reach out.

Find resources: https://t.co/BogsUYxPPO https://t.co/X9Rm3mG4fy

As opportunities grow within the base, so do the opportunities outside the fence. Wright-Patterson Air Force Base contributes to much more than our national defense. These investments create thousands of jobs and bring billions of dollars to our region, strengthening our community and providing opportunity.

Energy independence is critical to our economic and national security. I have long supported an all-of-the-above approach to domestic energy production. Through strengthening strategic partnerships with key allies and lifting unreasonable restrictions on energy production we can help grow both our workforce and economy.

The sky is no longer the limit in the birthplace of aviation! Wright-Patt serves as an integral part of both our local community and our national security, and continues to grow. From a new Advanced Materials Research Laboratory, a new Space Force intelligence facility, to potentially becoming the home of the nations newest service academy; the United States Space Academy. As the base grows our security is strengthened as well as our community.

Learn more about my work on WPAFB: https://t.co/9V2veOH6Kw

The number of jobs at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base has nearly doubled during my time in Congress, and the base continues to grow. That growth attracts additional jobs and investment outside the fence. Wright-Patterson is the economic engine of our region and an instrumental asset to our national security.

This year marks 100 years of Kettering Health Dayton (formally Grandview Hospital) providing vital medical care to our community. Join me in congratulating them on this significant milestone.

Read my full statement here: https://t.co/THUPmCLzyB https://t.co/AG0a9SwuEX

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. About 1 in 8 women in the U.S. will  be diagnosed with breast cancer in her lifetime, and early detection remains one of the strongest tools we have. I encourage you to get regular screenings and stay healthy. https://t.co/4Cbgnlvlf8

Aviation is part of who we are as a community, and Wright-Patterson Air Force Base is an economic engine that continues to drive our region’s growth. As Ohio’s largest single-site employer, the base supports more than 38,000 jobs and generates an estimated $16.68 billion in annual economic impact across the region. We remain committed to building on that success and investing in the base’s continued growth.

See my work on WPAFB here: https://t.co/9V2veOHEA4

We can not allow Russian aggression to succeed in Europe. Our adversaries are watching closely, and hope our resolve will diminish. Putin’s murderous war against the Ukrainian people has not broken apart the free people of the world, it has deepened our ties further. https://t.co/Kkex4B6yO4

This has always been about keeping a promise to the Delphi salaried retirees who earned these pensions through years of work.

I’ve been proud to stand with them, and I’ll keep pushing until that promise is finally kept.

🔗https://t.co/SB5cFlxVSW

Part of what makes and keeps America strong is our allies. My meeting with German Minister of Defense, Boris Pistorius underscores the strong relationship between our nations. 🇺🇸 🤝 🇩🇪 https://t.co/ZRQ1KJVup0

📧 Subscribe to my newsletter to receive updates on my work in Washington!

Subscribe here: https://t.co/jwyRTrSMJE https://t.co/qun6mlSE2H

⚙ Today is Manufacturing Day, and the Dayton region has always been a place that makes things. From the cash register and the pop-top can to the airplane and countless other innovations, our region has helped shape the way America lives and works.

Manufacturing has changed, but its importance to our regional and national economy has not. Today, we celebrate the makers, craftsmen, and manufacturers who carry that legacy forward and are building the next generation of American innovation.

I’ve worked with Central State to expand its access to federal resources as an 1890 land-grant institution, and I’m pleased to see this new $1.7 million investment in its students. I look forward to our continued partnership as we prepare the future’s innovators at Central State.

Read more: https://t.co/XvKWtUwAJh

Wright-Patt is more than a base, it is the backbone of the Miami Valley economy. It's the largest single-site employer in Ohio, supporting tens of thousands of military, civilian, and contractor jobs and pumping billions into the regional economy every year. From aerospace research to cybersecurity to logistics, the ripple effects hit every neighborhood through housing demand, small business traffic, workforce pipelines, supply chains and more. Wright-Patt’s customers, contracts, and a talent pool keep our region competitive nationally. Protecting and growing that relationship protects the Miami Valley’s economic future and the nation.

See my work on WPAFB: https://t.co/9V2veOH6Kw

PBMs are middlemen that stand between your insurance and your prescription drug costs. The Lower Health Care Premiums for All Americans Act, which I voted for, requires PBMs to disclose drug list costs and net prices to plan sponsors and employers. Pricing transparency allows for better negotiation and better prices for you and your family.

Learn more about the Lower Health Care Premiums for All Act here: https://t.co/8g5RSslpEU

🦅 It was especially meaningful to see the two young eagles at Carillon Historical Park take flight right here in Dayton, a community whose history has always been tied to innovation and flight. I submitted their story into the Congressional Record, titled “Young Bald Eagles Symbolize American Freedom and Resilience,” recognizing the birth of these eaglets and the historic recovery of the bald eagle population in the United States. 🇺🇸

https://t.co/QX2I6BBayJ
Ensuring our allies, like Ukraine, have advanced missile defense technology not only diminishes Putin’s ability to murder civilians but also strengthens the West as a whole. https://t.co/aHRmpCDpKT

For me, the fight for federal pensions is rooted in principle. Workers make career and retirement decisions based on the compensation and benefits they are promised in exchange for their service. When those benefits have been earned, I fight to ensure the government keeps our promise to deliver those earned benefits.

Learn how I fight: https://t.co/MoNppMrjwo
